title: Why you still need a Website Portfolio, even though everyone can Vibe Code it.
why_read: A casual opinion piece arguing developer portfolios still matter in the AI era, but it's light on technical substance and reads more like a blog teaser.
analysis: The article argues that developer portfolios remain valuable even though AI tools can quickly generate a passable website, framing this as a build-up to the author's own portfolio reveal. It doesn't present any specific technical techniques, benchmarks, or implementation details, making it more of a personal reflection than a technical resource.
